high_level_description: A detailed digital painting of a retro-futuristic robot repairing a pocket watch at a cluttered workbench, warm lamp light, steampunk details.

compositional_deconstruction.background: Cramped workshop with shelves full of jars, gears and copper pipes, a round porthole window showing a foggy harbour, warm light from a green-shaded desk lamp.

elements.desc: Small round-bodied robot with brass plating, riveted seams, two thin articulated arms and large glass lens eyes, leaning over the bench.
Open pocket watch lying on a felt pad, its tiny gears visible, held in place by a pair of tweezers in the robot's right hand.
Magnifying glass on an adjustable arm positioned between the robot's eyes and the watch.
Scattered screws, springs and a small oil can on the scratched wooden workbench surface.
Cat-shaped clockwork toy sitting on the shelf behind the robot, watching.
Hand-painted white letters on a small wooden sign hanging on the back wall, uppercase, bold, upright, small.
Steam rising from a chipped enamel mug of tea at the left edge of the bench.
